_source: Illustrative generic LEO smallsat carrying the EPS this project simulates. Numbers are copied from backend/eps/params.py on main (TRUTH table; 'assumed' or 'fitted: NASA PCoE' as stated there); nothing else is a spec. Subsystem layout is representative, not any operator's design.
disclaimer: Illustrative bus · subsystem layout is representative, not the operator's design

parts.name: Bus structure
parts.role: Primary structure that carries every subsystem.

parts.name: Solar wings (+Y, -Y)
parts.role: Two deployable wings turn sunlight into bus power.

parts.name: Battery pack
parts.role: Li-ion pack that carries the bus through eclipse.

parts.name: PCDU
parts.role: Power conditioning & distribution: regulates the wings, charges the battery, switches the loads.

parts.name: On-board computer
parts.role: Runs flight software and time-tagged commands.

parts.name: ADCS
parts.role: Reaction wheels and magnetorquers point the spacecraft.

parts.name: GNSS antenna
parts.role: Position and time for orbit determination.

parts.name: S-band antenna
parts.role: Uplink of commands and downlink of telemetry during passes.

parts.name: Payload imager
parts.role: The mission instrument; its duty cycle is the main power lever.

parts.name: Heater and radiator panel
parts.role: Keeps the battery warm; the radiator sheds heat.

parts.name: AUX line
parts.role: Secondary payload / RF amplifier line, normally off.

parts.name: Propulsion module
parts.role: Tank and thruster for orbit and collision-avoidance burns; not an EPS load in this simulation.
